rationale: The router explicitly registers singular user/activation under the admin prefix; the contract explicitly declares plural users/activation.
The handler deliberately invokes JSON binding and the utility explicitly rejects non-JSON Content-Type. The operation explicitly lists streaming request media types; empty bodies bypass validation.
Exhausted deletion retries explicitly throw CONFLICT, mapped to 409. The contract merely omits that response; it does not explicitly forbid it.
Malformed URL handling calls Error, which writes an error body but omits a status assignment. The verify operation explicitly documents 200 success and 401 unauthorized.
The invoice error branch lacks a return, so execution falls through to ResponseOk after ResponseError. The operation declares one Response object.
⚠️ Renaming mappings exist only from model to DTO; toModel lacks inverse mappings. Field descriptions explicitly define the renamed values. Generated mapper code is absent, limiting certainty.
An explicit length guard rejects oversized messages with INVALID_REQUEST; configuration defaults to 4000. The contract requires message but is silent about maximum length.

⚠️ Verification scans only the supplied context's references; deletion passes assetId alone. The owner-context check is missing. The operation explicitly promises deletion from the given context; asset-manager internals are absent.
The deletion handler explicitly parses query filters and forwards them to DeleteAllRelationTuples. The contract declares no parameters, which is silence rather than a dedicated restriction.
The handler explicitly constructs a typed 500 response for metadata lookup errors, including translated missing-resource errors. The operation explicitly lists 404 for NotFound.
The admin group explicitly applies AdminAuth before the language-options handler. The contract's operation and root omit a security requirement.
Unknown flags explicitly take BlankResult(nil), whose initialized flagID is zero, and batch results use an OK response. The minimum comes from the shared evalResult schema.
The parser explicitly accepts absence as zero; the engine explicitly replaces nonpositive depth with its global limit. The operation explicitly marks max-depth required.
The response explicitly counts with includeSuppressed=true, while the findings query explicitly excludes suppressed entries. Dedicated annotation prose promises all findings and their total count.
The mapper explicitly filters the combined catalog through enabledEnrichers, affecting both scopes. Dedicated contract prose describes own flag-scoped enrichers plus enabled built-ins.
The flavor parser explicitly accepts every EnabledFlavors entry, including glob. The role-delete parameter explicitly describes regex and exact.

Multipart upload explicitly dispatches ScanUploadEvent; its subscriber invokes DependencyCheckParser. The POST annotation explicitly states CycloneDX or SPDX inputs. This codes the event choice without inferring developer intent.
Batch evaluation iterates only FlagIds and never reads FlagKeys, omitting the key-processing path. The accepted string array and minLength derive from the shared request schema.

Output cleanup conversion omits PurgeOnDelete, leaving its boolean zero value; input conversion copies it. This GET relies on shared process schemas; explicit Add/Update wording belongs to the separate config endpoint.
Issuer failure explicitly invokes ReplyStatusCode(500), choosing a plain status reply. The operation explicitly specifies application/json and the generic OpenID error schema for 500.
The resource explicitly constructs ClusteSummaryEntity and sets clusterSummary. The operation explicitly names ControllerStatusEntity, whose property is controllerStatus.
The implementation explicitly annotates the commandtypes handler GET. The contract explicitly assigns the path a POST operation.
Unknown flags explicitly return BlankResult(nil) with flagID initialized to zero; the handler returns OK. The minimum is inherited from the shared evalResult schema.
The router explicitly registers singular org/keys/{keyName}, including GET. The contract explicitly declares plural orgs/keys/{keyID}.
Explicit routes bind the slashless memory path to ListFiles and the slash-wildcard path to GetFile. The contract explicitly declares a trailing-slash listing path.
The authenticated API group explicitly applies MustAuthAndAccountAvailable before RemoveTag. The contract omits any operation or root security requirement.
Parsing accepts empty namespace and persistence explicitly adds the namespace restriction only when nonempty. The query parameter explicitly has required=true.
The route explicitly names :hash and the handler reads hash. The contract's required path parameter is explicitly named thumb despite its hash path placeholder.
Unknown IDs cause UpdateProcess errors, and the handler explicitly converts update errors to 400. The operation explicitly lists 404 Not Found.
The dispatcher explicitly catches undecodable parameters before routing and writes INVALID_REQUEST, mapped to 400. The contract merely omits 400 from the operation's responses.

⚠️ GetInterface directly retrieves configuration and returns it, omitting request-body binding or enforcement. The contract explicitly requires data with AddCommentReq; no explicit body-ignore branch establishes a targeted omission.
The list response mapper explicitly filters all effective enrichers by enabled, including flag-scoped entries. Dedicated contract prose promises flag-scoped enrichers plus enabled built-ins.
The persistence mapper has an explicit else branch setting parent null. POST documentation explicitly says omission or null preserves the existing parent.
The resource explicitly returns ControllerServiceReferencingComponentsEntity with its referencing-components property. The GET annotation explicitly names ControllerServiceEntity.
The handler explicitly serializes the []Label search result. The operation explicitly references one search.Label object as its successful response.
Successful POST login logs the event and returns User without assigning USER_ID_KEY in the HTTP session. The contract explicitly describes creating a new session.
The parser accepts absent fields; persistence explicitly applies object and relation filters only when nonempty. Both operation parameters explicitly have required=true.
⚠️ Filtering declares a nil Policies result and never initializes an empty collection before passing it to the JSON writer. The operation declares an array; writer internals are absent.
UserResource explicitly returns Collection<User>. The operation explicitly specifies an array whose items reference Position.

Constraint deletion uses constraintID alone; flagID is used for mutation bookkeeping without a membership check. The contract explicitly nests the operation under required flagID and segmentID parameters.

Output cleanup conversion lacks PurgeOnDelete, leaving false despite copying it on input. The GET contract exposes shared process schemas; explicit Add/Update wording is attached to the separate config endpoint.
Segment deletion uses segmentID without restricting flag membership; flagID only drives mutation bookkeeping. The operation explicitly requires flagID within its nested path.
The DAO query lacks outer pagination and its entire list becomes the response. Pagination is promised through the reused PaginatedApi annotation, not dedicated component-operation prose.
The handler explicitly wraps identifiers in apiAllKeys, whose JSON property is keys. Operation prose and response schema explicitly promise an array of key identifiers.

⚠️ The callback checks context, affected components, and controller-service references, but omits inherited-context read checks. Dedicated security requirements explicitly cover current and new inherited contexts; downstream authorization internals are absent.
HEAD uses VerifyGet; malformed URL handling writes an error body without setting a failure status. HEAD documentation explicitly assigns 200 to success and 401 to unauthorized access.
Explicit routes bind slashless disk listing to ListFiles and slash-wildcard requests to GetFile. The contract explicitly declares the listing path with a trailing slash.
The handler puts false into a value struct; the vendored query builder omits blank fields and defines false as blank. Dedicated parameter prose promises the supplied enabled status.
⚠️ The handler selects a template view and the resolver explicitly sets text/html. The endpoint annotation explicitly declares text/plain. Framework view-resolution code is not supplied.
The router explicitly registers DELETE under singular org/keys/{keyName} beneath /tyk. The contract explicitly places the operation under plural orgs/keys/{keyID}.

The writer explicitly emits query_time, record_count, page_size, and labels. The operation's inline response schema explicitly names took, total, num, and field.
